scope: Newer GTA V menu choices for PS4 game updates1.56/1.57 and later, native PS5 GTA V, and newer RDR2 menu delivery. Primary-source review only; no payloads executed.
decision: No newly verified supported standalone GTA V menu BIN/ELF imported. Modern PS4 plugin downloads should be prioritized; legacy standalone payloads should remain compatibility-specific.

findings: Release description refers to a standalone GTA-V.elf and its checksum file lists one, but the actual release assets exclude that ELF and the direct URL returns404.
Tagged BUILDING.md describes unresolved model-streaming/clothing-preview regressions in experimental ELF source and explicitly says not to distribute its output as the supported build.
The supported published delivery is the Windows installer using PS5Debug-NG1.3.2, not a ready console-host ELF. No Windows package was added to console downloads.
Main README describes trainer1.1.1, while the inspected latest published release is1.1.0; trainer release and game update versions are separate.
Only active Story Mode and matching executable fingerprints are allowed; other game builds and GTA Online are refused. Firmware targets do not establish per-feature hardware validation.
The located1.47/1.67 lead describes a GoldHEN PRX plugin, not a standalone BIN/ELF.
A primary-author release with verifiable newer executable and loader mapping was not located in this review.
No new download or run action added.
Existing preserved V7 archive/extracted files contain LushModz-Expulsion-1.57.prx and supporting data/Lua files.
A PRX plugin requires plugin installation and matching configuration. It must not be renamed or sent as a standalone BIN/ELF.
Modern plugin frontpage integration is handled by the console-plugin task.

candidates.format: SPRX plugin through TacHen Beta3 compatibility bridge
findings: TacHen author README identifies official Havana1.2 rdr3Payload_132.sprx as the initially recognized GoldHEN plugin and reports a community test on PS5firmware13.42 with RDR2game1.32.
This is the PS4 RDR2 game running on PS5, not a native PS5 game menu or a standalone menu ELF.
Other plugins and broad additional firmware profiles require separate validation; no generic support claim or automatic Send action is established.

nextSteps: Prioritize ready PS4 GTA V1.56/1.57 plugin downloads and exact installer requirements.
Retain older standalone menu versions under a legacy/older-game filter rather than removing files.
Add native Run only after a supported public ready ELF/BIN and exact loader route can be verified.
